sourceText: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.
wikipediaObservedExcerpt: The Tribe of Naphtali was one of the northernmost of the twelve tribes of Israel.
reasonJa: Root authorized the existing book-local person:naphtali_2149 card to represent the collective tribe at 1KI7:14. Geographic uses in 4:15 and 15:20 remain excluded; no ancestral-person claim is made.
